<thought>Considering the fragment list, several fragments contain chlorine on both the phenyl ring and the heterocycle (e.g., “Clc1ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)cn1”). A plausible full molecule that accounts for these fragments is an ethyl ester of a dichlorinated anilide linking a chlorinated pyridine. The SMILES “CCOC(=O)c1c(Cl)ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)c1” captures an ethyl benzoate core with a chlorine on the phenyl ring and an aniline‑linked chloropyridine, matching the observed chlorine‑containing fragments while remaining a neutral, chemically reasonable structure.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)c1c(Cl)ccc(Nc2ccc(Cl)nc2)c1</final_answer>
